seo.title: Kling 3 Turbo Standard AI Video: 720p, Audio & Price
seo.description: Generate 3–15-second Kling 3 Turbo Standard videos at 720p from text or an opening image, with native audio and multishot prompting.

overview: Kling 3 Turbo Standard is the value-focused 720p route for fast drafts, social concepts, and structured multishot sequences with native audio.

hero.title: Kling 3.0 Turbo Standard
hero.subtitle: Fast 720p text-to-video and image-to-video for 3–15-second drafts, social clips, and multishot concepts.
hero.paragraph: Choose Standard when iteration cost and speed matter more than final 1080p delivery. Use one prompt or a timed sequence of up to six shots.

features.title: 720p value tier
features.body: A lower-cost route for rapid concept tests and approved social drafts.

features.title: 3–15-second clips
features.body: Choose any whole-second duration and match the number of story beats to the runtime.

features.title: Structured multishot prompts
features.body: Direct up to six timed shots while preserving the same subject, prop, and visual language.

features.title: Native audio
features.body: Generate dialogue, ambience, and effects with the picture.

decisionCards.title: Choose Standard for iteration
decisionCards.body: Use 720p Standard to test hooks, staging, rhythm, and multishot structure before a higher-finish pass.

decisionCards.title: See Turbo Pro in 1080p
decisionCards.body: Choose Standard when iteration cost and speed matter more than final 1080p delivery. Use one prompt or a timed sequence of up to six shots.

referenceWorkflows.title: Text-to-video
referenceWorkflows.body: Give each shot one action, one camera instruction, and one sound cue.

referenceWorkflows.title: Image-to-video
referenceWorkflows.body: Animate one opening image by describing motion and camera.

section.title: Prompt Lab — Kling 3 Turbo Standard
section.intro: Keep each shot short, visual, and easy to verify.
section.tip: For multishot work, name each shot and make all shot durations add up to the selected total.

tabs.title: Build a timed sequence
tabs.description: Give each shot one action, one camera instruction, and one sound cue.
tabs.copy: Shot 1: a courier protects a silver parcel beneath a station awning. Shot 2: the same parcel travels in a bicycle basket through rain. Shot 3: the courier hands it to a baker at a warm doorway. Preserve the parcel, rain, direction, and color grade.
